scope: Actual emitted production10 WASM and official synchronous decoder correctness; no browser/FPS/GC measurement

check_names: Actual module exports optional UI transport
Ordinary UI without image registry uses leased wire
Leased ordinary UI preserves full canonical state and digest
Actual WASM lease decodes to private deeply immutable owned UI
120 unchanged ticks preserve UI object identity, generation, pointer and revision
Changed UI creates a new owned generation while old snapshots remain unchanged
Changed encoded UI advances revision in the same epoch
Disabled transport publishes complete inline UI with unchanged digest
Re-enable retains epoch and never reuses a retired revision
UI, artwork, save and encoded instances coexist without digest changes
UI lease coexists with memory instances and full canonical digest
Equal UI bytes retain UI generation while fresh resource definitions and private logical usage update
Removing the final artwork retires its registry while keeping current UI, save and instance leases
No-UI world preserves absent canonical UI and direct publication
New runtime uses a distinct epoch even when initial UI bytes are identical
Unload clears the current publication and decoder ownership cache
wire.original_failure: Cache-only fixture used key/value save.set instead of canonical whole-payload save.set. Production code unchanged; failed raw report preserved.

check_names: Actual selected production ABI has no developer entry
Actual WASM ordinary deep freeze/detach/COW/granted bounds and shared DAG assertions execute
Actual WASM publishes unchanged canonical child data
Actual bundled package executes through normal fixed tick
Bundled WASM package resists global/getfenv/setfenv shadowing and cached-cost/depth/cycle bypass
Managed __eq impostor assertions pass through actual public composer
Actual WASM counts shared leaves and retained quads against original screen budget
UI-only request does not run Game.update or advance simulation
Actual WASM managed handle materializes requested range through frozen ancestors
Old detached published snapshot remains unchanged
Malformed virtual materialization fails publication
Actual WASM live private contents and published UI roll back after failed materialization
Managed request resumes after failure without an extra tick
Actual WASM retires handle and revalidates stale mutable descendants
Stale retired UI request cannot resurrect old content
Actual WASM unload clears publication
Fresh runtime after unload rebuilds valid private ownership state

limitations: Actual emitted production WASM/Luau + synchronous official decoder only. No browser, GPU, worker scheduling, FPS, GC-frequency or leak-free verdict.
Escaped >64MiB fallback, developer reload rollback and canonical scratch retirement are native ABI gates; this small actual-WASM fixture does not allocate a >64MiB UI.
